Negrona is the revered serpent river goddess of the Rio Negro, a major tributary of the Amazon River in South America. She is often depicted as a serpentine deity, with a sinuous and majestic form that symbolizes the river's winding course through the Amazon rainforest. Negrona is associated with fertility, abundance, and the mysterious powers of the river that sustain the rich biodiversity of the Amazon.
